recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes the stale over-restrictive invariant while preserving the later date-aware $preferred-id operation wording and the non-overlap guidance for preferred identifiers.
issue_request: FHIR-22105 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested that NamingSystem nsd-2 account for uniqueId.period, including the period-aware behavior needed by $preferred-id.
initial_application: Commit 25159ea161eaed360cf05d040c52d38e80cdcbac listed FHIR-22105 among broad NamingSystem R5 updates but retained the original type-only nsd-2 expression. Later $preferred-id commits added date-aware operation behavior, but the core invariant still rejected period-distinct preferred identifiers of the same type.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-37673 chose the $preferred-id input name date and added guidance that preferred identifiers for the same type should not overlap by period; FHIR-37674 clarified operation behavior when multiple identifiers match; FHIR-43169 confirmed the current nsd-3 type/start/end FHIRPath pattern. Confluence minutes and policy notes support one preferred identifier per type for a given period.
reconciliation: Updated source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml so nsd-2 compares preferred identifiers by type plus period.start plus period.end, updated the invariant text, added nsd-2 as a condition on uniqueId.period, and added a passing nsd-2 invariant fixture with two preferred identifiers of the same type in distinct periods.
source_changes: source/namingsystem/structuredefinition-NamingSystem.xml: changed nsd-2 from type-only uniqueness to type plus period.start plus period.end uniqueness and marked uniqueId.period as participating in nsd-2.
source/namingsystem/invariant-tests/nsd-2.p1.pass.xml: added a passing fixture for two preferred identifiers of the same type with different periods.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up that chose date rather than effective for $preferred-id and added the preferred-identifier period-overlap guidance.
Published follow-up clarifying $preferred-id behavior for multiple identifiers at the specified date.
Applied later correction confirming the type/start/end period-combination FHIRPath pattern used by nsd-3 and mirrored for nsd-2.
Deprecated identifier policy discussion noted that FHIR-22105's valid-period update had not reached nsd-2.
